data.name: FTD A400M
data.rulesAndSafety:
• Please, make sure your Airbus Military ID card is visible at any time.

• It is forbidden to access to the simulator with drinks or food.

• Smoking is forbidden.

• There is a telephone at the IOS for any emergency or enquiry. Telephone numbers are:
1. Simulator Maintenance & Operation Technicians & Engineers: 690 698 937 or. 955 423 745
2. San Pablo Sur Factory Emergencies: 8181

• In case of emergency, the following emergency stops buttons are available:
1. IOS desk 

• In case of fire, use the fire extinguishers in front the Training Room (TC550) or in front the Computer room (TC527).

• The Instructor is responsible for the right use of the simulator by the trainees while the training session is being performed.

• The Instructor must have enough knowledge about how to operate the simulator. With his/her signature in the Operation Report, the Instructor certifies such knowledge.

• The Instructor must sign the Operation Report Form as acknowledgement of receipt for this information BEFORE starting the training session.

• Before starting the training, the Instructor is responsible for the instruction of these procedures and rules detailed in this document to all the trainees, showing the position of each of the mentioned elements (Emergency Power Off, fire extinguishers…). This briefing should be repeated by the instructor for each new trainee member in the training session. For any question, enquiry or suggestion, please contact Maintenance & Operation Team (phone: 690 698 937).

By this signature, the instructor agrees that he/she complies with the Flight and Duty Time Limitations and rest requirements established by this Training Organization (not applicable for Customer Instructors)
